description: The North Sea Transition Authority publishes a point-in-time Subsea Decommissioning Collaboration pipeline layer for the North Sea and UK Continental Shelf. It combines voluntarily supplied operator information with public NSTA data to support lower decommissioning costs. Schema fields cover pipeline identity, fluid, status, diameter, length, material, burial and decommissioning assumptions. The source says the data have not been quality assured, assumes operator submissions are correct and has no plans for updates. Coverage is the UK Continental Shelf. Access is through the published ArcGIS feature service. Licence and cost: The source names the NSTA Open User Licence; its linked full text was not inspected. Caveats: only item, service and layer metadata were inspected. No feature records were downloaded, and current completeness, geometric quality and operational availability remain untested. Access charges are not stated in the inspected metadata. The resource provides mapped infrastructure or service inputs; applying it in a simulation requires checking the source limits and relevant model assumptions. Related NSTA records describe the regularly updated UKCS offshore infrastructure layers.
